    function setInvestorLimit(uint256 maxInvestors_) external onlyOwner {

    function setInvestorLimitForJurisdiction(
        uint256[] calldata jurisdictions,
        uint256[] calldata limits
    ) external onlyOwner {
        if (jurisdictions.length != limits.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jurisdictions.length; i++) {
            _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdictions[i]] = limits[i];
            emit MaxInvestorsByJurisdictionChanged(jurisdictions[i], limits[i]);

    function configWhitelist(uint256 startDate_, uint256 granularity_) external onlyOwner {
        if (granularity_ == 0) revert InvalidValue();
        _startDate = startDate_;
        _lockupGranularity = granularity_;
        emit ConfigWhitelist(startDate_, granularity_, msg.sender);

    function approveNewUsers(address[] calldata wallets, uint256[] calldata userIds) external onlyOperator {

            uint256 userId = userIds[i];

        }
    }

            _jurisdictionByUserId[userId] = jurisdictions[i];
            emit UpdateJurisdictionForUserId(wallets[i], jurisdictions[i], msg.sender);

    ) external onlyOwner {

            emit Halt(jurisdictions[i], untilTimestamps[i]);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jurisdictions.length; i++) {
            _jurisdictionHaltUntil[jurisdictions[i]] = 0;
            emit Resume(jurisdictions[i]);
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _activateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
            _enlistInvestorInternal(wallets[i]);

            _activateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
            _enlistInvestorInternal(wallets[i]);
        }
    }

    function deactivateWallets(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _deactivateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function deactivateWallet(address wallet) external onlyOperator {
        _deactivateWalletInternal(wallet, msg.sender);
    }

    function revokeUserWallets(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {

            uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
            if (userId == 0) continue;

            _revokedFrom[wallet] = _approvedWallet[wallet];

            if (_walletActivated[wallet]) {
                _walletActivated[wallet] = false;
                if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] > 0) {

            delete _approvedWallet[wallet];

            emit RevokeUserWallet(wallet, msg.sender);
        }
    }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _addLockup(wallets[i], amounts[i], releaseTimes[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function processLockups(address wallet, uint256 maxCount) external {
        _processLockupsInternal(wallet, maxCount, true, msg.sender);
    }

    function forceUnlockUpTo(address wallet, uint256 maxCount) external onlyOperator {
        _processLockupsInternal(wallet, maxCount, false, msg.sender);
    }

    function getUserIdLockup(address wallet, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256 amount, uint256 releaseTime) {
        Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][index];
        return (l.amount, l.releaseTime);
    }

    function getLockedTokenCount(address wallet) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 total = _lockedTokenCount[wallet];
        if (total == 0) return 0;

        uint256 cursor = _lockupCursor[wallet];
        uint256 len = _lockupLength[wallet];
        for (uint256 i = cursor; i < len; i++) {
            Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][i];
            if (l.amount == 0) continue;
            if (l.releaseTime <= block.timestamp) {
                if (l.amount >= total) return 0;
                total -= l.amount;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    function getAuthorizedUserIdInfo(address wallet)

        jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        lockedTokens = getLockedTokenCount(wallet);
    }

    function detectTransferRestriction(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public view returns (uint8) {
        if (_startDate != 0 && block.timestamp < _startDate) return 3;

        uint256 toUserId = to == address(0) ? 0 : _walletToUserId[to];

        if (from != address(0) && (!_walletActivated[from] || fromUserId == 0 || !_investorEnlisted[from])) return 3;
        if (to != address(0) && (!_walletActivated[to] || toUserId == 0)) return 3;

        uint256 fromJurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[fromUserId];
        uint256 toJurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[toUserId];

        if (from != address(0) && _jurisdictionHaltUntil[fromJurisdiction] > block.timestamp) return 4;
        if (to != address(0) && _jurisdictionHaltUntil[toJurisdiction] > block.timestamp) return 4;

        if (from != address(0) && to != address(0) && fromJurisdiction != toJurisdiction) {
            uint256 flowLimit = _jurisdictionFlow[fromJurisdiction][toJurisdiction];
            if (flowLimit == 0 || amount > flowLimit) return 1;
        }

        if (from != address(0)) {
            uint256 bal = _balanceOf(from);
            uint256 locked = getLockedTokenCount(from);
            if (bal < amount) return 2;
            if (bal - amount < locked) return 2;
        }

        return 0;
    }

        if (code == 0) return "SUCCESS";
        if (code == 1) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_FLOW";
        if (code == 2) return "DENIED: LOCKUP";
        if (code == 3) return "DENIED: NOT_AUTHORIZED";
        if (code == 4) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_HALT";
        return "DENIED";
    }

    function authorizeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount, bool bypass) external onlyCallingContract {
        if (bypass) return;
        uint8 code = detectTransferRestriction(from, to, amount);
        if (code != 0) revert(messageForTransferRestriction(code));
        if (from != address(0)) {
            _processLockupsInternal(from, type(uint256).max, true, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _addLockup(address wallet, uint256 amount, uint256 releaseTime, address operator_) internal {
        if (wallet == address(0) || amount == 0) revert InvalidValue();
        if (_lockupGranularity != 0 && amount % _lockupGranularity != 0) revert InvalidValue();
        if (releaseTime != 0 && releaseTime <= block.timestamp) revert InvalidValue();

        uint256 idx = _lockupLength[wallet];
        _lockups[wallet][idx] = Lockup(amount, releaseTime);
        _lockupLength[wallet] = idx + 1;
        _lockedTokenCount[wallet] += amount;

        emit AddLockup(wallet, amount, releaseTime, operator_);
    }

    function _processLockupsInternal(address wallet, uint256 maxCount, bool maturedOnly, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 cursor = _lockupCursor[wallet];
        uint256 len = _lockupLength[wallet];
        uint256 processed;

        while (cursor < len && processed < maxCount) {
            Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][cursor];

            if (maturedOnly && l.releaseTime > block.timestamp) break;

            if (l.amount > 0) {
                uint256 amount = l.amount;
                l.amount = 0;
                if (_lockedTokenCount[wallet] >= amount) {
                    _lockedTokenCount[wallet] -= amount;
                } else {
                    _lockedTokenCount[wallet] = 0;
                }
                emit UnlockTokens(wallet, amount, operator_);
            }

            cursor++;
            processed++;
        }

        _lockupCursor[wallet] = cursor;
    }

    function _activateWalletInternal(address wallet, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();

        if (!_walletActivated[wallet]) {
            _walletActivated[wallet] = true;
            _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] += 1;
            emit WalletActivated(wallet, operator_);
        }
    }

    function _deactivateWalletInternal(address wallet, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) return;

        if (_walletActivated[wallet]) {
            _walletActivated[wallet] = false;
            if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] > 0) {
                _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] -= 1;
            }
            emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, operator_);
        }

        if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] == 0 && _investorEnlisted[wallet]) {
            _delistInvestorInternal(wallet);
        }
    }

    function _enlistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();
        if (_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        if (_maxInvestors != 0) {
            require(_currentInvestors + 1 <= _maxInvestors, "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS");
        }

        uint256 maxByJ = _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction];
        if (maxByJ != 0) {
            require(
                _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] + 1 <= maxByJ,
                "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS_BY_JURISDICTION"
            );
        }

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = true;
        _currentInvestors += 1;
        _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] += 1;

        emit InvestorEnlisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _delistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        if (!_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = false;
        if (_currentInvestors > 0) _currentInvestors -= 1;
        if (_currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] > 0) {
            _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] -= 1;
        }

        emit InvestorDelisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _balanceOf(address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_callingContract == address(0)) return type(uint256).max;
        try IERC20Like(_callingContract).balanceOf(account) returns (uint256 bal) {
            return bal;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }
}

            price0CumulativeLast += ((uint256(_r1) * UQ112) / _r0) * timeElapsed;

        uint256 age = block.timestamp - uint256(virtualPriceTimestamp);
        if (age >= DECAY_PERIOD) return pool;

        return (v * (DECAY_PERIOD - age) + pool * age) / DECAY_PERIOD;
    }

    function _poolPrice(address token) private view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == token0) {
            if (reserve0 == 0) return 0;

    function _reservesForOut(address tokenOut) private view returns (uint256 rIn, uint256 rOut) {

        if (token == token0) return lockedIn0;

    }

    function _isPairPath(address a, address b) private view returns (bool) {
        return (a == token0 && b == token1) || (a == token1 && b == token0);
    }

    function _min(uint256 x, uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256) {
        return x < y ? x : y;
    }

    function _ceilDiv(uint256 x, uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256) {
        return x == 0 ? 0 : ((x - 1) / y) + 1;
    }

    function _sqrt(uint256 y) private pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (y > 3) {
            z = y;
            uint256 x = (y / 2) + 1;
            while (x < z) {
                z = x;
                x = (y / x + x) / 2;
            }
        } else if (y != 0) {
            z = 1;
        }
    }

        out.data1 = m.data1;
        out.data2 = m.data2;
        out.data3 = m.data3;
        out.data4 = m.data4;

    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {

        return (spender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender) || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory str) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 i = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            i--;
            buffer[i] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        str = string(buffer);
    }

        return (_shareholdersPoolValue, _stakeholdersPoolAuthorizedValue);
    }

    function buybackReserve() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 base = _manualBuybackReserveValue;
        if (_currencyAddr == address(0)) return base + address(this).balance;
        return base + IERC20Like(_currencyAddr).balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32) {
        if (block.chainid == _initialChainId) return _domainSeparator;
        return _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function initializeDomainSeparator() external {
        _setDomainSeparator();
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 added) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + added);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtracted) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 current = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(current >= subtracted, "DECREASED_BELOW_ZERO");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, current - subtracted);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 current = _allowances[from][msg.sender];
        if (current != type(uint256).max) {
            require(current >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_ALLOWANCE");
            _approve(from, msg.sender, current - amount);
        }
        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyBeneficiary {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external onlyBeneficiary {
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
        _burnedSupplyValue += amount;
        emit Burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function estimateBuyValue(uint256 valueIn) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buySlopeDenValue == 0) return valueIn;
        return (valueIn * _buySlopeNumValue) / _buySlopeDenValue;
    }

    function estimateSellValue(uint256 tokenIn) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_buySlopeNumValue == 0) return 0;
        return (tokenIn * _buySlopeDenValue) / _buySlopeNumValue;
    }

    function buy(address receiver, uint256 valueIn, uint256 minOut) external payable {
        _buyInternal(msg.sender, receiver, valueIn, minOut, true);
    }

    function convertToCafe(uint256 valueIn, uint256 minOut, address receiver) external onlyBeneficiary {
        require(_currencyAddr != address(0), "NO_CURRENCY_TOKEN");
        _buyInternal(msg.sender, receiver, valueIn, minOut, false);
    }

    function manualBuy(address receiver, uint256 valueIn) external onlyBeneficiary {
        uint256 tokenOut = estimateBuyValue(valueIn);
        _mint(receiver, tokenOut);
        _shareholdersPoolValue += tokenOut;
        _stakeholdersPoolIssuedValue += tokenOut;
        emit Buy(msg.sender, receiver, valueIn, tokenOut);
    }

    function sell(address receiver, uint256 tokenIn, uint256 minOut) external {
        require(_stateValue != 0, "INVALID_STATE");
        uint256 valueOut = estimateSellValue(tokenIn);
        require(valueOut >= minOut, "PRICE_SLIPPAGE");

        _burn(msg.sender, tokenIn);
        _burnedSupplyValue += tokenIn;

        if (_currencyAddr == address(0)) {
            (bool ok, ) = payable(receiver).call{value: valueOut}("");
            require(ok, "ETH_TRANSFER_FAILED");
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(_currencyAddr, receiver, valueOut);
        }

        emit Sell(msg.sender, receiver, tokenIn, valueOut);
    }

    function batchTransfer(address[] calldata tos, uint256[] calldata amounts) external {
        require(tos.length == amounts.length, "LENGTH_MISMATCH");
        require(tos.length <= 10, "TOO_MANY");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tos.length; i++) {
            _transfer(msg.sender, tos[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }

    function increaseValuation(uint256 amount) external onlyBeneficiary {
        _initGoalValue += amount;
    }

    function increaseCommitment(uint256 commitment, uint256 reserve) external onlyBeneficiary {
        _equityCommitmentValue = commitment;
        _initReserveValue = reserve;
    }

    function close() external onlyBeneficiary {
        _stateValue = 3;
        _trialEndedOnValue = block.timestamp;
        emit Close();
    }

    function updateConfig(
        address whitelist_,
        address control_,
        address setupFeeRecipient_,
        address feeCollector_,
        uint256 feeBasisPoints_,
        uint256 gasFee_,
        uint256 minDuration_,
        uint256 buySlopeNum_,
        uint256 buySlopeDen_
    ) external onlyControl {
        require(control_ != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        require(feeBasisPoints_ <= 10_000, "INVALID_FEE");
        require(buySlopeNum_ > 0 && buySlopeDen_ > 0, "INVALID_SLOPE");

        _whitelistAddr = whitelist_;
        _controlAddr = control_;
        _setupFeeRecipientAddr = setupFeeRecipient_;
        _feeCollectorAddr = feeCollector_;
        _feeBasisPointsValue = feeBasisPoints_;
        _gasFeeValue = gasFee_;
        _minDurationValue = minDuration_;
        _buySlopeNumValue = buySlopeNum_;
        _buySlopeDenValue = buySlopeDen_;

        emit UpdateConfig(
            _whitelistAddr,
            _controlAddr,
            _setupFeeRecipientAddr,
            _feeCollectorAddr,
            _feeBasisPointsValue,
            _gasFeeValue,
            _minDurationValue,
            _buySlopeNumValue,
            _buySlopeDenValue
        );
    }

    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "EXPIRED");
        uint256 nonce = _nonces[owner]++;
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, nonce, deadline));
        _validateSig(owner, structHash, v, r, s);
        _approve(owner, spender, value);
    }

    function permitBuy(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        _permitWithType(PERMIT_BUY_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, deadline, nonce, v, r, s);
    }

    function permitSell(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        _permitWithType(PERMIT_SELL_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, deadline, nonce, v, r, s);
    }

    function _permitWithType(
        bytes32 typeHash,
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) internal {
        require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "EXPIRED");
        require(nonce == _nonces[owner], "INVALID_NONCE");
        _nonces[owner] = nonce + 1;
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(typeHash, owner, spender, value, nonce, deadline));
        _validateSig(owner, structHash, v, r, s);
        _approve(owner, spender, value);
    }

    function _buyInternal(
        address payer,
        address receiver,
        uint256 valueIn,
        uint256 minOut,
        bool useMsgValue
    ) internal {
        require(_stateValue != 0, "INVALID_STATE");
        require(receiver != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");

        if (_currencyAddr == address(0)) {
            if (useMsgValue) {
                require(msg.value == valueIn, "INCORRECT_MSG_VALUE");
            } else {
                require(msg.value == 0, "NO_ETH_ALLOWED");
            }
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "NO_ETH_ALLOWED");
            _safeTransferFrom(_currencyAddr, payer, address(this), valueIn);
        }

        uint256 fee = (valueIn * _feeBasisPointsValue) / 10_000;
        uint256 net = valueIn - fee;

        if (fee > 0 && _feeCollectorAddr != address(0)) {
            if (_currencyAddr == address(0)) {
                (bool ok, ) = payable(_feeCollectorAddr).call{value: fee}("");
                require(ok, "FEE_TRANSFER_FAILED");
            } else {
                _safeTransfer(_currencyAddr, _feeCollectorAddr, fee);
            }
        }

        uint256 out = estimateBuyValue(net);
        require(out >= minOut, "PRICE_SLIPPAGE");

        _mint(receiver, out);
        _initInvestorsMap[receiver] += net;
        _shareholdersPoolValue += out;
        _stakeholdersPoolIssuedValue += out;

        emit Buy(payer, receiver, net, out);
    }

    function _validateSig(address owner, bytes32 structHash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal view {
        require(owner != address(0), "INVALID_OWNER");
        bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", _domainSeparatorV4(), structHash));
        address recovered = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(recovered != address(0) && recovered == owner, "INVALID_SIGNATURE");
    }

    function _setDomainSeparator() internal {
        _initialChainId = block.chainid;
        _domainSeparator = _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function _domainSeparatorV4() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        if (block.chainid == _initialChainId) return _domainSeparator;
        return _buildDomainSeparator();
    }

    function _buildDomainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
                keccak256(bytes(_nameToken)),
                keccak256(bytes(_versionString)),
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0) && to != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        _totalSupplyToken += amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        uint256 bal = _balances[from];
        require(bal >= amount, "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE");
        _balances[from] = bal - amount;
        _totalSupplyToken -= amount;
        emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0) && spender != address(0), "INVALID_ADDRESS");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(ok, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FAILED");
        if (ret.length > 0) require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value)
        );
        require(ok, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED");
        if (ret.length > 0) require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "TOKEN_TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED");
    }
}

        acceptanceThreshold = value;
    }

    function setMinQuorum(uint256 value) external onlySelf {
        require(value > 5, "quorum must be > 5");
        require(value <= 100, "must be <= 100");
        minQuorum = value;
    }

    function setSmartPoolAddress(address pool) external onlySelf {
        smartPool = pool;
    }

    function setSmartPoolInitial(address pool) external {
        require(smartPool == address(0), "Can only initialize smartPool address once");
        smartPool = pool;
    }

    function triggerApplyAddToken() external {
        if (smartPool == address(0)) return;
        try ISmartPoolLike(smartPool).applyAddToken() {} catch {}
    }

    function triggerWeightUpdate() external {
        if (controller == address(0) || smartPool == address(0)) return;

        try IWeightControllerLike(controller).updateBasketBalance() {} catch {}

        address[] memory tokens;
        try IWeightControllerLike(controller).getTokens() returns (address[] memory t) {
            tokens = t;
        } catch {
            return;
        }

        uint256[] memory targetWeights = new uint256[](tokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            try IWeightControllerLike(controller).getTargetAllocation(tokens[i]) returns (uint256 w) {
                targetWeights[i] = w;
            } catch {
                targetWeights[i] = 0;
            }
        }

        uint256 endTs = block.timestamp.add(gradualWeightUpdate);
        try ISmartPoolLike(smartPool).updateWeightsGradually(targetWeights, block.timestamp, endTs) {} catch {}
    }

    function propose(
        address[] calldata targets,
        uint256[] calldata values,
        string[] calldata signatures,
        bytes[] calldata calldatas,
        string calldata title,
        string calldata description
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        _validateProposalInputs(
            targets.length,
            values.length,
            signatures.length,
            calldatas.length,
            bytes(title).length,
            bytes(description).length
        );

        _ensureActiveForProposal();
        _ensureNoLiveProposal(msg.sender);

        uint256 proposalId = lastProposalId.add(1);
        lastProposalId = proposalId;

        _initializeProposal(proposalId, msg.sender, title, description);
        _storeProposalActions(proposalId, targets, values, signatures, calldatas);

        latestProposalIds[msg.sender] = proposalId;
        emit ProposalCreated(proposalId);

        return proposalId;
    }

    function proposals(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 id,
            address proposer,
            string memory title,
            string memory description,
            uint256 creationTime,
            uint256 eta,
            uint256 forVotes,
            uint256 againstVotes,
            bool canceled,
            bool executed,
            uint256 proposalAcceptanceThreshold,
            uint256 proposalMinQuorum
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        return (
            p.id,
            p.proposer,
            p.title,
            p.description,
            p.creationTime,
            p.eta,
            p.forVotes,
            p.againstVotes,
            p.canceled,
            p.executed,
            p.pAcceptanceThreshold,
            p.pMinQuorum
        );
    }

    function getActions(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            address[] memory targets,
            uint256[] memory values,
            string[] memory signatures,
            bytes[] memory calldatas
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];

        targets = new address[](p.targets.length);
        values = new uint256[](p.values.length);
        signatures = new string[](p.signatures.length);
        calldatas = new bytes[](p.calldatas.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) targets[i] = p.targets[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.values.length; i++) values[i] = p.values[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.signatures.length; i++) signatures[i] = p.signatures[i];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.calldatas.length; i++) calldatas[i] = p.calldatas[i];
    }

    function getProposalParameters(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 proposalWarmUpDuration,
            uint256 proposalActiveDuration,
            uint256 proposalQueueDuration,
            uint256 proposalGracePeriodDuration,
            uint256 proposalAcceptanceThreshold,
            uint256 proposalMinQuorum
        )
    {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        return (
            p.pWarmUpDuration,
            p.pActiveDuration,
            p.pQueueDuration,
            p.pGracePeriodDuration,
            p.pAcceptanceThreshold,
            p.pMinQuorum
        );
    }

    function state(uint256 proposalId) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _state(proposalId);
    }

    function getProposalQuorum(uint256 proposalId) public view returns (uint256) {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        require(p.id != 0, "proposal not found");
        uint256 staked = _reignStakedAtTs(p.creationTime);
        if (staked == 0) return p.pMinQuorum;
        return staked.mul(p.pMinQuorum).div(100);
    }

    function queue(uint256 proposalId) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 4, "Proposal can only be queued if succeeded");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];

        uint256 eta = block.timestamp.add(p.pQueueDuration);
        p.eta = eta;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                eta
            ));
            require(!queuedTransactions[txHash], "proposal action already queued at eta");
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = true;
        }

        emit ProposalQueued(proposalId, msg.sender, eta);
    }

    function execute(uint256 proposalId) external payable {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 6, "proposal not executable");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.executed = true;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                p.eta
            ));
            require(queuedTransactions[txHash], "transaction not queued");
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;

            bytes memory callData;
            if (bytes(p.signatures[i]).length == 0) {
                callData = p.calldatas[i];
            } else {
                callData = abi.encodePacked(bytes4(keccak256(bytes(p.signatures[i]))), p.calldatas[i]);
            }

            (bool ok, ) = p.targets[i].call{value: p.values[i]}(callData);
            require(ok, "proposal action failed");
        }

        emit ProposalExecuted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function cancelProposal(uint256 proposalId) external {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        require(p.id != 0, "proposal not found");
        require(!p.executed, "already executed");
        require(msg.sender == p.proposer || msg.sender == address(this), "cannot cancel");

        p.canceled = true;
        if (p.eta != 0) {
            _clearQueuedTransactions(p);
        }

        emit ProposalCanceled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function castVote(uint256 proposalId, bool support) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 1, "Proposal not active");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        Receipt storage r = p.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(!r.hasVoted, "Already voted this option");

        uint256 votes = _votingPowerAtTs(msg.sender, p.creationTime);
        if (support) p.forVotes = p.forVotes.add(votes);
        else p.againstVotes = p.againstVotes.add(votes);

        r.hasVoted = true;
        r.support = support;
        r.votes = votes;

        emit Vote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, votes);
    }

    function cancelVote(uint256 proposalId) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 1, "Proposal not active");
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        Receipt storage r = p.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(r.hasVoted, "Cannot cancel if not voted yet");

        if (r.support) p.forVotes = p.forVotes.sub(r.votes);
        else p.againstVotes = p.againstVotes.sub(r.votes);

        r.hasVoted = false;
        r.support = false;
        r.votes = 0;

        emit VoteCanceled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function getReceipt(uint256 proposalId, address voter)
        external
        view
        returns (bool hasVoted, bool support, uint256 votes)
    {
        Receipt storage r = _proposals[proposalId].receipts[voter];
        return (r.hasVoted, r.support, r.votes);
    }

    function startAbrogationProposal(uint256 proposalId, string calldata description) external {
        require(_state(proposalId) == 5, "Proposal must be in queue");
        require(bytes(description).length > 0, "description can't be empty");

        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id == 0, "Abrogation proposal already exists");

        ap.id = proposalId;
        ap.proposer = msg.sender;
        ap.description = description;
        ap.startTime = block.timestamp;
        ap.endTime = block.timestamp.add(activeDuration);

        emit AbrogationProposalStarted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function abrogationProposals(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 id,
            address proposer,
            string memory description,
            uint256 startTime,
            uint256 endTime,
            uint256 forVotes,
            uint256 againstVotes,
            bool canceled,
            bool executed
        )
    {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        return (
            ap.id,
            ap.proposer,
            ap.description,
            ap.startTime,
            ap.endTime,
            ap.forVotes,
            ap.againstVotes,
            ap.canceled,
            ap.executed
        );
    }

    function abrogationProposal_castVote(uint256 proposalId, bool support) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "not active");
        require(block.timestamp <= ap.endTime, "abrogation proposal ended");

        Receipt storage r = ap.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(!r.hasVoted, "Already voted this option");

        uint256 votes = _votingPowerAtTs(msg.sender, ap.startTime);
        if (support) ap.forVotes = ap.forVotes.add(votes);
        else ap.againstVotes = ap.againstVotes.add(votes);

        r.hasVoted = true;
        r.support = support;
        r.votes = votes;

        emit AbrogationProposalVote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, votes);
    }

    function abrogationProposal_cancelVote(uint256 proposalId) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "not active");

        Receipt storage r = ap.receipts[msg.sender];
        require(r.hasVoted, "Cannot cancel if not voted yet");

        if (r.support) ap.forVotes = ap.forVotes.sub(r.votes);
        else ap.againstVotes = ap.againstVotes.sub(r.votes);

        r.hasVoted = false;
        r.support = false;
        r.votes = 0;

        emit AbrogationProposalVoteCancelled(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function getAbrogationProposalReceipt(uint256 proposalId, address voter)
        external
        view
        returns (bool hasVoted, bool support, uint256 votes)
    {
        Receipt storage r = _abrogationProposals[proposalId].receipts[voter];
        return (r.hasVoted, r.support, r.votes);
    }

    function abrogateProposal(uint256 proposalId) external {
        AbrogationProposal storage ap = _abrogationProposals[proposalId];
        require(ap.id != 0, "abrogation proposal not found");
        require(!ap.executed && !ap.canceled, "already finalized");
        require(block.timestamp > ap.endTime, "abrogation proposal still active");
        require(ap.forVotes > ap.againstVotes, "abrogation not approved");

        ap.executed = true;

        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.canceled = true;
        p.abrogated = true;
        if (p.eta != 0) {
            _clearQueuedTransactions(p);
        }

        emit AbrogationProposalExecuted(proposalId, msg.sender);
    }

    function _validateProposalInputs(
        uint256 targetsLength,
        uint256 valuesLength,
        uint256 signaturesLength,
        uint256 calldatasLength,
        uint256 titleLength,
        uint256 descriptionLength
    ) internal pure {
        require(targetsLength == valuesLength, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targetsLength == signaturesLength, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targetsLength == calldatasLength, "proposal function information mismatch");
        require(targetsLength > 0, "Must provide actions");
        require(targetsLength <= MAX_ACTIONS, "Too many actions on a vote");
        require(titleLength > 0, "title can't be empty");
        require(descriptionLength > 0, "description can't be empty");
    }

    function _ensureActiveForProposal() internal {
        if (!_active) {
            require(_reignStaked() > 0, "DAO not yet active");
            _active = true;
        }
    }

    function _ensureNoLiveProposal(address proposer) internal view {
        uint256 latestId = latestProposalIds[proposer];
        if (latestId != 0) {
            require(_isFinalState(_state(latestId)), "One live proposal per proposer");
        }
    }

    function _initializeProposal(
        uint256 proposalId,
        address proposer,
        string calldata title,
        string calldata description
    ) internal {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        p.id = proposalId;
        p.proposer = proposer;
        p.title = title;
        p.description = description;
        p.creationTime = block.timestamp > 0 ? block.timestamp.sub(1) : 0;

        p.pWarmUpDuration = warmUpDuration;
        p.pActiveDuration = activeDuration;
        p.pQueueDuration = queueDuration;
        p.pGracePeriodDuration = gracePeriodDuration;
        p.pAcceptanceThreshold = acceptanceThreshold;
        p.pMinQuorum = minQuorum;
    }

    function _storeProposalActions(
        uint256 proposalId,
        address[] calldata targets,
        uint256[] calldata values,
        string[] calldata signatures,
        bytes[] calldata calldatas
    ) internal {
        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
            p.targets.push(targets[i]);
            p.values.push(values[i]);
            p.signatures.push(signatures[i]);
            p.calldatas.push(calldatas[i]);
        }
    }

    function _state(uint256 proposalId) internal view returns (uint256) {
        require(proposalId > 0 && proposalId <= lastProposalId, "invalid proposal id");

        Proposal storage p = _proposals[proposalId];
        if (p.id == 0) return 0;
        if (p.abrogated) return 9;
        if (p.canceled) return 2;
        if (p.executed) return 8;

        uint256 votingStart = p.creationTime.add(p.pWarmUpDuration);
        if (block.timestamp <= votingStart) return 0;

        uint256 votingEnd = votingStart.add(p.pActiveDuration);
        if (block.timestamp <= votingEnd) return 1;

        uint256 totalVotes = p.forVotes.add(p.againstVotes);
        uint256 quorumVotes = getProposalQuorum(proposalId);
        if (totalVotes < quorumVotes || totalVotes == 0) return 3;
        if (p.forVotes.mul(100) < totalVotes.mul(p.pAcceptanceThreshold)) return 3;

        if (p.eta == 0) return 4;
        if (block.timestamp < p.eta) return 5;
        if (block.timestamp <= p.eta.add(p.pGracePeriodDuration)) return 6;
        return 7;
    }

    function _isFinalState(uint256 st) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return (st == 2 || st == 3 || st == 7 || st == 8 || st == 9);
    }

    function _clearQueuedTransactions(Proposal storage p) internal {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < p.targets.length; i++) {
            bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(
                p.targets[i],
                p.values[i],
                p.signatures[i],
                p.calldatas[i],
                p.eta
            ));
            queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;
        }
    }

    function _reignStaked() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.reignStaked.selector)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _reignStakedAtTs(uint256 ts) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.reignStakedAtTs.selector, ts)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function _votingPowerAtTs(address who, uint256 ts) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (reign == address(0)) return 0;
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = reign.staticcall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(IReignLike.votingPowerAtTs.selector, who, ts)
        );
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return 0;
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }
}

        _stageWL[stageId].root = root;
    }

    function merkleTreeRoot(uint8 stageId) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _stageWL[stageId].root;
    }

    function addToWhitelist(uint8 stageId, address[] calldata accounts) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _stageWL[stageId].manual[accounts[i]] = true;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(uint8 stageId, address[] calldata accounts) external onlyAdmin {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _stageWL[stageId].manual[accounts[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function isWhitelisted(uint8 stageId, address account, bytes32[] calldata proof) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isWhitelisted(stageId, account, proof);
    }

    function currentBalance(uint8 stageId, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stageBal[stageId].minted[account];
    }

    function remainingBalance(uint8 stageId, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 lim = _stageBal[stageId].limit;
        if (lim == 0) return 0;
        uint256 used = _stageBal[stageId].minted[account];
        return used >= lim ? 0 : lim - used;
    }

    function maxSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxSupply_;
    }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 value) external onlyAdmin {
        require(value >= _totalMinted_, "Exceeds supply");
        _maxSupply_ = value;
    }

    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        bytes32[] memory proof = new bytes32[](0);
        _mintWithStage(msg.sender, quantity, proof, 1);
    }

    function multiStageMint(uint256 quantity, bytes32[] calldata proof, uint8 stageId) external payable {
        _mintWithStage(msg.sender, quantity, proof, stageId);
    }

    function adminMint(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata quantities) external onlyAdmin {
        require(recipients.length == quantities.length, "Admin mint: bad request");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _mint(recipients[i], quantities[i]);
        }
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalMinted_;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "Balance query for zero");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _ownerships[tokenId].addr;
        require(o != address(0), "Owner query for nonexistent token");
        return o;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (TokenOwnership memory) {
        if (tokenId >= _totalMinted_) return TokenOwnership(address(0), 0, false, 0);
        TokenOwnership memory own = _ownerships[tokenId];
        if (own.addr == address(0)) return TokenOwnership(address(0), 0, false, 0);
        return own;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipsOf(uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external view returns (TokenOwnership[] memory out) {
        out = new TokenOwnership[](tokenIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            out[i] = explicitOwnershipOf(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address account) external view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        uint256 count = _balances[account];
        ids = new uint256[](count);
        if (count == 0) return ids;
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _totalMinted_ && idx < count; i++) {
            if (_ownerships[i].addr == account) ids[idx++] = i;
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwnerIn(address account, uint256 start, uint256 stop) external view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        require(start < stop, "InvalidQueryRange");
        if (stop > _totalMinted_) stop = _totalMinted_;
        ids = new uint256[](stop - start);
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < stop; i++) {
            if (_ownerships[i].addr == account) ids[idx++] = i;
        }
        assembly { mstore(ids, idx) }
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "URI query for nonexistent token");
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_prefix_, _toString(tokenId), _suffix_));
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(msg.sender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, msg.sender), "Not owner nor approved");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(tokenOwner, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "Approval query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ApproveToCaller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        if (_operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator]) return true;
        return _proxyApproved(tokenOwner, operator);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "Transfer caller not owner nor approved");
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "Transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "Transfer to zero");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _ownerships[tokenId] = TokenOwnership(to, uint64(block.timestamp), false, 0);
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "Non ERC721Receiver");
    }

    function setRoyalties(address receiver, uint256 feeNumerator) external onlyAdmin {
        _setRoyalties(receiver, feeNumerator);
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = _royaltyReceiver;
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royaltyFeeBps) / 10000;
    }

    function totalShares() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalShares_; }
    function totalReleased() external view returns (uint256) { return _totalReleasedEth_; }
    function totalReleased(address token) external view returns (uint256) { return _erc20TotalReleased[token]; }
    function shares(address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _sharesByPayee[account]; }
    function released(address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _releasedEthByPayee[account]; }
    function released(address token, address account) external view returns (uint256) { return _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account]; }
    function payeesLength() external view returns (uint256) { return _payees.length; }
    function payee(uint256 index) external view returns (address) { return _payees[index]; }

    function releasable(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalShares_ == 0) return 0;
        uint256 totalReceived = address(this).balance + _totalReleasedEth_;
        return (totalReceived * _sharesByPayee[account]) / _totalShares_ - _releasedEthByPayee[account];
    }

    function releasable(address token, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalShares_ == 0) return 0;
        uint256 totalReceived = IERC20Minimal(token).balanceOf(address(this)) + _erc20TotalReleased[token];
        return (totalReceived * _sharesByPayee[account]) / _totalShares_ - _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account];
    }

    function release(address payable account) public {
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(account);
        require(payment > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");

        _releasedEthByPayee[account] += payment;
        _totalReleasedEth_ += payment;

        (bool ok, ) = account.call{value: payment}("");
        require(ok, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");

        emit PaymentReleased(account, payment);
    }

    function release(address token, address account) public {
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(token, account);
        require(payment > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");

        _erc20ReleasedByTokenAndPayee[token][account] += payment;
        _erc20TotalReleased[token] += payment;

        require(IERC20Minimal(token).transfer(account, payment), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        emit ERC20PaymentReleased(token, account, payment);
    }

    function releaseAll() external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            address payable p = payable(_payees[i]);
            uint256 due = releasable(p);
            if (due > 0) release(p);
        }
    }

    function releaseAll(address token) external {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            address p = _payees[i];
            uint256 due = releasable(token, p);
            if (due > 0) release(token, p);
        }
    }

    function _mintWithStage(address to, uint256 quantity, bytes32[] memory proof, uint8 stageId) internal {
        require(quantity > 0, "MintZeroQuantity");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "No bots");
        require(_stageEnabled(stageId), "Current stage is not enabled");

        StageBalance storage sb = _stageBal[stageId];
        if (sb.limit > 0) {
            require(sb.minted[to] + quantity <= sb.limit, "Balance limit");
            sb.minted[to] += quantity;
        }

        if (_stageWL[stageId].root != bytes32(0) || _stageWL[stageId].manual[to] || proof.length > 0) {
            require(_isWhitelisted(stageId, to, proof), "Not whitelisted");
        }

        uint256 cost = _priceByStage[stageId] * quantity;
        require(msg.value >= cost, "Insufficient payment");
        if (msg.value > cost) {
            (bool ok, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: msg.value - cost}("");
            require(ok, "Refund failed");
        }

        _mint(to, quantity);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 quantity) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "Mint to zero");
        require(quantity > 0, "MintZeroQuantity");
        if (_maxSupply_ != 0) {
            require(_totalMinted_ + quantity <= _maxSupply_, "Exceeds supply");
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _totalMinted_;
            _totalMinted_++;
            _ownerships[tokenId] = TokenOwnership(to, uint64(block.timestamp), false, 0);
            _balances[to] += 1;
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _setRoyalties(address receiver, uint256 feeNumerator) internal {
        require(receiver != address(0), "Royalty receiver zero");
        require(feeNumerator <= 10000, "Royalties: value is too high");
        _royaltyReceiver = receiver;
        _royaltyFeeBps = uint96(feeNumerator);
        emit RoyaltiesSet(receiver, feeNumerator);
    }

    function _addPayee(address account, uint256 shares_) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "PaymentSplitter: account is the zero address");
        require(shares_ > 0, "PaymentSplitter: shares are 0");
        require(_sharesByPayee[account] == 0, "PaymentSplitter: account already has shares");

        _payees.push(account);
        _sharesByPayee[account] = shares_;
        _totalShares_ += shares_;

        emit PayeeAdded(account, shares_);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _ownerships[tokenId].addr != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || getApproved(tokenId) == spender || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender));
    }

    function _stageEnabled(uint8 s) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (s == 0) return false;
        return _stage_ == s || ((_stage_ & s) == s);
    }

    function _isWhitelisted(uint8 stageId, address account, bytes32[] memory proof) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (_stageWL[stageId].manual[account]) return true;
        bytes32 root = _stageWL[stageId].root;
        if (root == bytes32(0)) return false;
        return _verify(proof, root, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account)));
    }

    function _verify(bytes32[] memory proof, bytes32 root, bytes32 leaf) internal pure returns (bool) {
        bytes32 computed = leaf;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            bytes32 p = proof[i];
            computed = computed <= p ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(computed, p)) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(p, computed));
        }
        return computed == root;
    }

    function _proxyApproved(address tokenOwner, address operator) internal view returns (bool) {
        address registry = _proxyRegistryAddress(block.chainid);
        if (registry == address(0)) return false;
        try IProxyRegistry(registry).proxies(tokenOwner) returns (address proxy) {
            return proxy == operator;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }

    function _proxyRegistryAddress(uint256 cid) internal pure returns (address) {
        if (cid == 1) return 0xa5409ec958C83C3f309868babACA7c86DCB077c1;
        if (cid == 137) return 0x58807baD0B376efc12F5AD86aAc70E78ed67deaE;
        if (cid == 4) return 0xF57B2c51dED3A29e6891aba85459d600256Cf317;
        if (cid == 80001) return 0xff7Ca10aF37178BdD056628eF42fD7F799fAc77c;
        if (cid == 1337) return 0xE1a2bbc877b29ADBC56D2659DBcb0ae14ee62071;
        return address(0);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    }
