contract ElderGods {
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    event NFTListedForRent(uint256 tokenId, uint64 minDuration, uint64 maxDuration, uint256 price, address paymentToken);
    event NFTDeletedFromRent(uint256 tokenId);
    event BidPlaced(uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, uint64 minDuration, uint64 maxDuration, uint256 bidId, address paymentToken);
    event BidDeleted(uint256 tokenId);
    event UpdateUser(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed user, uint64 expires);

    struct UserInfo {
        address user;
        uint64 expires;
    }

    struct RentableItem {
        uint256 price;
        uint64 minDuration;
        uint64 maxDuration;
        address paymentToken;
        address lender;
    }

    struct RentBid {
        uint256 price;
        uint64 minDuration;
        uint64 maxDuration;
        address paymentToken;
        address bidder;
    }

    string private _nameValue;
    string private _symbolValue;
    string private _baseURIValue;
    string private _baseExtensionValue;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    uint256[] private _allTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _allTokensIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _ownedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    address private _owner;
    uint256 private _status;

    address public OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY;
    address public treasury;
    address public ELDERGODS_old;
    address public constant WETH = 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2;

    mapping(address => bool) public allowedTokens;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _isSloth;
    mapping(uint256 => UserInfo) private _users;
    mapping(uint256 => RentableItem) private _rentableItems;
    mapping(uint256 => RentBid) private _rentBids;

    uint256 public godsFee;
    uint256 public rentBidsCounter;
    bool public canRent;

    uint256 private _airdropCursor;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = 2;
        _;
        _status = 1;
    }

    modifier rentEnabled() {
        require(canRent, "GODS: Rent is currently disabled");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _nameValue = "ELDERGODS";
        _symbolValue = "GODS";
        _baseExtensionValue = ".json";

        _owner = msg.sender;
        treasury = msg.sender;
        _status = 1;

        canRent = true;
        allowedTokens[WETH] = true;

        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert("Invalid call");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert("Invalid call");
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 ||
            interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd ||
            interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f ||
            interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 ||
            interfaceId == 0x2b424ad7;
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _nameValue;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbolValue;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC721: address zero is not a valid owner");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _owners[tokenId];
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return o;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _balances[account], "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[account][index];
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        ownerOf(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator];
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != tokenOwner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(
            msg.sender == tokenOwner || _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][msg.sender],
            "ERC721: approve caller is not token owner or approved for all"
        );
        _checkOperatorAllowed(to);
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        if (approved) _checkOperatorAllowed(operator);
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (bytes(_baseURIValue).length == 0) return "";
        return string.concat(_baseURIValue, _toString(tokenId), _baseExtensionValue);
    }

    function setBaseURI(string calldata newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURIValue = newBaseURI;
    }

    function setBaseExtension(string calldata newExtension) external onlyOwner {
        _baseExtensionValue = newExtension;
    }

    function changeOperatorFilterRegistryAddress(address registry) external onlyOwner {
        OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY = registry;
    }

    function changeTreasuryAddress(address newTreasury) external onlyOwner {
        treasury = newTreasury;
    }

    function changeRentFee(uint256 newFee) external onlyOwner {
        require(newFee < 1000, "GODS: fee too high");
        godsFee = newFee;
    }

    function setRentStatus(bool status) external onlyOwner {
        canRent = status;
    }

    function modifyAllowedTokens(address[] calldata tokens, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            allowedTokens[tokens[i]] = allowed;
        }
        require(allowedTokens[WETH], "GODS: WETH must stay enabled");
    }

    function isSloth(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isSloth[tokenId];
    }

    function airdrop(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        uint256 minted;
        uint256 cursor = _airdropCursor;

        if (ELDERGODS_old == address(0)) {
            while (minted < amount) {
                cursor++;
                _mint(treasury, cursor);
                _isSloth[cursor] = true;
                minted++;
            }
        } else {
            uint256 maxSupply = getEldersSupply();
            while (minted < amount && cursor < maxSupply) {
                cursor++;
                if (_owners[cursor] != address(0)) continue;

                address to;
                try IOldGods(ELDERGODS_old).ownerOf(cursor) returns (address o) {
                    to = o;
                } catch {
                    to = treasury;
                }
                if (to == address(0)) to = treasury;

                _mint(to, cursor);

                try IOldGods(ELDERGODS_old).isSloth(cursor) returns (bool s) {
                    _isSloth[cursor] = s;
                } catch {}
                minted++;
            }
        }

        _airdropCursor = cursor;
    }

    function returnToTreasury(uint256 tokenId) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _transfer(ownerOf(tokenId), treasury, tokenId);
    }

    function rent(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address user, uint64 expires) {
        UserInfo memory info = _users[tokenId];
        return (info.user, info.expires);
    }

    function userOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        UserInfo memory info = _users[tokenId];
        if (uint256(info.expires) >= block.timestamp) return info.user;
        return address(0);
    }

    function userExpires(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        UserInfo memory info = _users[tokenId];
        if (uint256(info.expires) >= block.timestamp) return info.expires;
        return 0;
    }

    function setUser(uint256 tokenId, address user, uint64 expires) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not token owner or approved");
        require(user != ownerOf(tokenId), "GODS: Lender cannot rent");
        require(uint256(expires) > block.timestamp, "GODS: Invalid expiry");
        _setUser(tokenId, user, expires);
    }

    function rentableItems(uint256 tokenId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 price,
            uint64 minDuration,
            uint64 maxDuration,
            address paymentToken,
            address lender
        )
    {
        RentableItem memory it = _rentableItems[tokenId];
        return (it.price, it.minDuration, it.maxDuration, it.paymentToken, it.lender);
    }

    function rentBids(uint256 tokenId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 price,
            uint64 minDuration,
            uint64 maxDuration,
            address paymentToken,
            address bidder
        )
    {
        RentBid memory b = _rentBids[tokenId];
        return (b.price, b.minDuration, b.maxDuration, b.paymentToken, b.bidder);
    }

    function putForRent(
        uint256 tokenId,
        uint64 minDuration,
        uint64 maxDuration,
        uint256 price,
        address paymentToken
    ) external rentEnabled nonReentrant {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not the owner");
        require(price >= 1000, "GODS: invalid price");
        require(minDuration > 0 && maxDuration >= minDuration, "GODS: invalid duration");

        if (paymentToken != address(0)) {
            require(allowedTokens[paymentToken], "GODS: token not allowed");
        }

        UserInfo memory info = _users[tokenId];
        require(info.user == address(0) || uint256(info.expires) < block.timestamp, "GODS: already rented");

        _rentableItems[tokenId] = RentableItem({
            price: price,
            minDuration: minDuration,
            maxDuration: maxDuration,
            paymentToken: paymentToken,
            lender: msg.sender
        });

        emit NFTListedForRent(tokenId, minDuration, maxDuration, price, paymentToken);
    }

    function deleteFromRent(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not the owner");
        delete _rentableItems[tokenId];
        emit NFTDeletedFromRent(tokenId);
    }

    function placeBid(
        uint256 tokenId,
        uint64 minDuration,
        uint64 maxDuration,
        uint256 price,
        address paymentToken
    ) external rentEnabled nonReentrant {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender, "GODS: Cannot rent own token");
        require(price >= 1000, "GODS: invalid bid");
        require(minDuration > 0 && maxDuration >= minDuration, "GODS: invalid duration");
        if (paymentToken != address(0)) {
            require(allowedTokens[paymentToken], "GODS: token not allowed");
        }

        _rentBids[tokenId] = RentBid({
            price: price,
            minDuration: minDuration,
            maxDuration: maxDuration,
            paymentToken: paymentToken,
            bidder: msg.sender
        });

        unchecked {
            rentBidsCounter++;
        }

        emit BidPlaced(tokenId, price, minDuration, maxDuration, rentBidsCounter, paymentToken);
    }

    function deleteBid(uint256 tokenId) external {
        RentBid memory b = _rentBids[tokenId];
        require(b.bidder == msg.sender || ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: not allowed");
        delete _rentBids[tokenId];
        emit BidDeleted(tokenId);
    }

    function acceptBid(uint256 tokenId) external rentEnabled nonReentrant {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender, "GODS: Caller is not the owner");

        RentBid memory b = _rentBids[tokenId];
        require(b.bidder != address(0), "GODS: no bid");

        UserInfo memory info = _users[tokenId];
        require(info.user == address(0) || uint256(info.expires) < block.timestamp, "GODS: already rented");

        _settlePayment(b.bidder, msg.sender, b.paymentToken, b.price);

        uint64 expires = uint64(block.timestamp + b.maxDuration);
        _setUser(tokenId, b.bidder, expires);

        delete _rentBids[tokenId];
    }

    function acceptRent(uint256 tokenId) external payable rentEnabled nonReentrant {
        RentableItem memory item = _rentableItems[tokenId];
        require(item.lender != address(0), "GODS: not listed");
        require(msg.sender != ownerOf(tokenId), "GODS: Cannot rent own token");

        if (item.paymentToken == address(0)) {
            require(msg.value == item.price, "GODS: Incorrect amount payed");
            _splitNative(item.lender, item.price);
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "GODS: ERC20 rent does not use ETH");
            require(allowedTokens[item.paymentToken], "GODS: token not allowed");
            _splitERC20From(msg.sender, item.lender, item.paymentToken, item.price);
        }

        uint64 expires = uint64(block.timestamp + item.maxDuration);
        _setUser(tokenId, msg.sender, expires);

        delete _rentableItems[tokenId];
    }

    function withdrawFunds() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        _sendValue(_owner, address(this).balance);
    }

    function getEldersSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (ELDERGODS_old == address(0)) return 0;
        try IOldGods(ELDERGODS_old).totalSupply() returns (uint256 s) {
            return s;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _setUser(uint256 tokenId, address user, uint64 expires) internal {
        _users[tokenId] = UserInfo(user, expires);
        emit UpdateUser(tokenId, user, expires);
    }

    function _settlePayment(address payer, address lender, address paymentToken, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(paymentToken != address(0), "GODS: bid token invalid");
        require(allowedTokens[paymentToken], "GODS: token not allowed");
        _splitERC20From(payer, lender, paymentToken, amount);
    }

    function _splitNative(address lender, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 fee = godsFee == 0 ? 0 : (amount * godsFee) / 1000;
        if (fee > 0) _sendValue(treasury, fee);
        _sendValue(lender, amount - fee);
    }

    function _splitERC20From(address payer, address lender, address token, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 fee = godsFee == 0 ? 0 : (amount * godsFee) / 1000;
        if (fee > 0) {
            _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, payer, treasury, fee));
        }
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Minimal.transferFrom.selector, payer, lender, amount - fee));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = token.call(data);
        require(ok, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (ret.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(ret, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Address: unable to send value");
    }

    function _checkOperatorAllowed(address operator) internal view {
        address registry = OPERATOR_FILTER_REGISTRY;
        if (registry != address(0) && registry.code.length > 0) {
            require(IOperatorFilterRegistry(registry).isOperatorAllowed(address(this), operator), "OperatorNotAllowed");
        }
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (
            spender == tokenOwner ||
            _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender ||
            _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][spender]
        );
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        unchecked {
            _balances[from] -= 1;
            _balances[to] += 1;
        }
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        if (_users[tokenId].user != address(0)) {
            delete _users[tokenId];
            emit UpdateUser(tokenId, address(0), 0);
        }

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(_owners[tokenId] == address(0), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _balances[to] += 1;

        _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 length = _balances[to] == 0 ? 0 : _balances[to] - 1;
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch {
            revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) private pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits++;
                temp /= 10;
            }
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            unchecked {
                digits -= 1;
                buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
                value /= 10;
            }
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

        }
        n.usedSpace += amount;
        _moveSpaceBucket(nodeId, beforeFree, _freeSpace(n));
        return true;
    }

    function deleteNodeForValidator(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeId) external onlyAuthorized {
        NodeData storage n = _node(nodeId);
        require(n.validatorId == validatorId, "Validator ID does not exist");

        _removeFromArray(_validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId], nodeId);

        uint8 oldFree = _freeSpace(n);
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[oldFree], nodeId);

        if (n.status != 3) {
            _setStatus(nodeId, 3);
        }

        _hasNodeForAddress[n.nodeAddress] = false;
        delete _nodeIndexes[n.nodeAddress];
    }

    function populateBountyV2(uint256 nodeId, uint256 bountyPeriodSeconds) external onlyAuthorized {
        require(bountyPeriodSeconds > 0, "Message sender is invalid");
        _bountyPeriodSeconds = bountyPeriodSeconds;
        _node(nodeId).lastRewardDate = block.timestamp;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role].members[account]) return;
        _roles[role].members[account] = true;
        _roles[role].memberList.push(account);
        _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account] = _roles[role].memberList.length;
        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!_roles[role].members[account]) return;
        _roles[role].members[account] = false;

        uint256 indexPlusOne = _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        if (indexPlusOne > 0) {
            uint256 idx = indexPlusOne - 1;
            uint256 last = _roles[role].memberList.length - 1;
            if (idx != last) {
                address lastAcc = _roles[role].memberList[last];
                _roles[role].memberList[idx] = lastAcc;
                _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[lastAcc] = indexPlusOne;
            }
            _roles[role].memberList.pop();
            delete _roles[role].memberIndexPlusOne[account];
        }

        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _setStatus(uint256 nodeId, uint8 newStatus) internal {
        NodeData storage n = _nodes[nodeId];
        uint8 old = n.status;
        if (old == newStatus) return;

        if (old == 0) _numberOfActiveNodes -= 1;
        else if (old == 2) _numberOfLeavingNodes -= 1;
        else if (old == 3) _numberOfLeftNodes -= 1;

        if (newStatus == 0) _numberOfActiveNodes += 1;
        else if (newStatus == 2) _numberOfLeavingNodes += 1;
        else if (newStatus == 3) _numberOfLeftNodes += 1;

        n.status = newStatus;
    }

    function _node(uint256 nodeId) internal view returns (NodeData storage) {
        require(nodeId < _nodes.length && _nodes[nodeId].exists, "Node with such index does not exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId];
    }

    function _freeSpace(NodeData storage n) internal view returns (uint8) {
        if (n.totalSpace <= n.usedSpace) {
            return 0;
        }
        return uint8(n.totalSpace - n.usedSpace);
    }

    function _moveSpaceBucket(uint256 nodeId, uint8 fromBucket, uint8 toBucket) internal {
        if (fromBucket == toBucket) return;
        _removeFromArray(_spaceToNodes[fromBucket], nodeId);
        _spaceToNodes[toBucket].push(nodeId);
    }

    function _removeFromArray(uint256[] storage arr, uint256 value) internal returns (bool) {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == value) {
                arr[i] = arr[arr.length - 1];
                arr.pop();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

            amountOut = _swap(token, SUSHI, amountOut, 0, address(0), "");
        }

        (amountOut, shareOut) = _depositToBento(SUSHI, msg.sender, amountOut);
    }

    function bridgeToken(address[] calldata tokensIn, address[] calldata tokensOut) external {
        uint256 len = _min(tokensIn.length, tokensOut.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (tokensIn[i] == tokensOut[i]) continue;
            uint256 amount = _balanceOf(tokensIn[i], msg.sender);
            if (amount == 0) continue;
            _safeTransferFrom(tokensIn[i], msg.sender, address(this), amount);
            uint256 out = _swap(tokensIn[i], tokensOut[i], amount, 0, address(0), "");
            _safeTransfer(tokensOut[i], msg.sender, out);
        }
    }

    function batch(bytes[] calldata calls, bool revertOnFail) external payable returns (bytes[] memory results) {
        results = new bytes[](calls.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(calls[i]);
            if (!success && revertOnFail) _revertWithData(result);
            results[i] = result;
        }
    }

    function _collectInput(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) internal returns (address inToken, uint256 pulled) {
        if (tokenIn == address(0)) {
            require(amountIn == 0 || amountIn == msg.value, "Invalid token amount");
            pulled = amountIn == 0 ? msg.value : amountIn;
            require(pulled > 0, "Invalid token amount");
            IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: pulled}();
            inToken = WETH;
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "Eth sent with token");
            inToken = tokenIn;
            pulled = amountIn;
            _safeTransferFrom(inToken, msg.sender, address(this), pulled);
        }
    }

    function _swap(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address target,
        bytes memory data
    ) internal returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        if (amountIn == 0 || tokenIn == tokenOut) return amountIn;

        uint256 beforeBal = _balanceOf(tokenOut, address(this));

        if (target != address(0) && data.length > 0) {
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, target, 0);
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, target, amountIn);
            _call(target, data, "No Swap Available");
        } else {
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, SUSHI_ROUTER, 0);
            _safeApprove(tokenIn, SUSHI_ROUTER, amountIn);
            address[] memory path = new address[](2);
            path[0] = tokenIn;
            path[1] = tokenOut;
            IRouter(SUSHI_ROUTER).swapExactTokensForTokens(
                amountIn,
                amountOutMin,
                path,
                address(this),
                block.timestamp
            );
        }

        amountOut = _balanceOf(tokenOut, address(this)).sub(beforeBal);
        require(amountOut >= amountOutMin, "ERR: High Slippage");
    }

    function _zapOutInternal(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 shareIn) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
        (uint256 amountIn,) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).withdraw(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), 0, shareIn);
        address outToken = tokenOut == address(0) ? WETH : tokenOut;
        amountOut = _swap(tokenIn, outToken, amountIn, 0, address(0), "");
        if (tokenOut == address(0)) {
            IWETH(WETH).withdraw(amountOut);
            _sendETH(msg.sender, amountOut);
            shareOut = 0;
        } else {
            _safeTransfer(tokenOut, msg.sender, amountOut);
            shareOut = 0;
        }
    }

    function _depositToBento(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
        _safeApprove(token, BENTOBOX, 0);
        _safeApprove(token, BENTOBOX, amount);
        (amountOut, shareOut) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).deposit(IERC20(token), address(this), to, amount, 0);
    }

    function _addAsset(address pair, address to, uint256 share) internal returns (uint256 fraction) {
        bytes memory ret = _call(
            pair,
            abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x1b51e940), to, false, share),
            "No Swap Available"
        );
        if (ret.length >= 32) fraction = abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _stakeToCream(uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 cAmount) {
        _safeApprove(SUSHI, CREAM_SUSHI, 0);
        _safeApprove(SUSHI, CREAM_SUSHI, amount);
        _mintCToken(CREAM_SUSHI, amount);
        cAmount = _balanceOf(CREAM_SUSHI, address(this));
    }

    function _unstakeSushiFromCreamFromBento(address recipient, uint256 shareIn) internal {
        (uint256 cAmount,) = IBentoBox(BENTOBOX).withdraw(IERC20(CREAM_SUSHI), msg.sender, address(this), 0, shareIn);
        _redeemCToken(CREAM_SUSHI, cAmount);
        uint256 sushiAmount = _balanceOf(SUSHI, address(this));
        if (sushiAmount > 0) _safeTransfer(SUSHI, recipient, sushiAmount);
    }

    function _mintCToken(address cToken, uint256 amount) internal {
        bytes memory ret = _call(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa0712d68), amount), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) require(abi.decode(ret, (uint256)) == 0, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _redeemCToken(address cToken, uint256 amount) internal {
        bytes memory ret = _call(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xdb006a75), amount), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) require(abi.decode(ret, (uint256)) == 0, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _miniChefLpToken(uint256 pid) internal view returns (address lpToken) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(MINI_CHEF_V2, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x78ed5d1f), pid), "No Swap Available");
        if (ret.length >= 32) lpToken = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _miniChefDeposit(uint256 pid, uint256 amount, address to) internal {
        _call(MINI_CHEF_V2, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x8dbdbe6d), pid, amount, to), "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _cTokenUnderlying(address cToken) internal view returns (address token) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(cToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x6f307dc3)), "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        require(ret.length >= 32, "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        token = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _aTokenUnderlying(address aToken) internal view returns (address token) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(aToken, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb16a19de)), "No Swap Available");
        require(ret.length >= 32, "No Swap Available");
        token = abi.decode(ret, (address));
    }

    function _balanceOf(address token, address user) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
        bytes memory ret = _staticCall(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x70a08231), user), "BoringERC20: BalanceOf failed");
        if (ret.length >= 32) amount = abi.decode(ret, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, amount), "BoringERC20: Transfer failed");
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x23b872dd), from, to, amount), "BoringERC20: TransferFrom failed");
    }

    function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x095ea7b3), spender, amount), "BoringERC20: Approve failed");
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), errorMessage);
        }
    }

    function _call(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory ret) {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        return returndata;
    }

    function _staticCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal view returns (bytes memory ret) {
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.staticcall(data);
        require(success, errorMessage);
        return returndata;
    }

    function _sendETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success,) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "No Swap Available");
    }

    function _revertWithData(bytes memory data) internal pure {
        if (data.length == 0) revert("Transaction reverted silently");
        assembly {
            revert(add(data, 32), mload(data))
        }
    }

    function _min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
}

                try IApeToken(cToken).registerCollateral(account) returns (bool) {} catch {}
            }
        } catch {}

        return 0;
    }

        if (!_accountMembership[account][cToken]) return 0;

        if (!ok) return 1;

        require(borrowBalance == 0, "nonzero borrow balance");

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = _getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(account, cToken, tokensHeld, 0);
        require(err == 0 && shortfall == 0, "insufficient liquidity");

        _accountMembership[account][cToken] = false;
        _removeAccountAsset(account, cToken);

        emit MarketExited(cToken, account);

        try IApeToken(cToken).version() returns (uint256 v) {
            if (v == 2) {
                try IApeToken(cToken).unregisterCollateral(account) returns (bool) {} catch {}
            }
        } catch {}

        return 0;
    }

    function _getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 sumCollateral;
        uint256 sumBorrowPlusEffects;

        address[] storage assets = _accountAssets[account];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address asset = assets[i];
            Market storage m = _markets[asset];
            if (!m.isListed) continue;

            (bool ok, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBal, uint256 exchangeRateMantissa) = _safeAccountSnapshot(asset, account);
            if (!ok) return (1, 0, 0);

            uint256 price = _safePrice(asset);
            if (price == 0) return (2, 0, 0);

            uint256 tokensToDenom = (cTokenBalance * exchangeRateMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
            uint256 collateral = (tokensToDenom * m.collateralFactorMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
            collateral = (collateral * price) / EXP_SCALE;

            sumCollateral += collateral;
            sumBorrowPlusEffects += (borrowBal * price) / EXP_SCALE;

            if (asset == cTokenModify) {
                uint256 redeemEffect = (redeemTokens * exchangeRateMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
                redeemEffect = (redeemEffect * m.collateralFactorMantissa) / EXP_SCALE;
                redeemEffect = (redeemEffect * price) / EXP_SCALE;
                sumBorrowPlusEffects += redeemEffect;
                sumBorrowPlusEffects += (borrowAmount * price) / EXP_SCALE;
            }
        }

        if (sumCollateral > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
            return (0, sumCollateral - sumBorrowPlusEffects, 0);
        }
        return (0, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects - sumCollateral);

        } catch {

        }

        internal
        view

    {
